tokenize_python_code: tokenize python source code into a list of normalized tokens with optional comment preservation
tokenize_cpp_code: tokenize C++ source code into a list of normalized tokens using clang parser with timeout protection
tokenize_java_code: tokenize Java source code into a list of normalized tokens using javalang parser
detokenize_python_code: detokenize a space-separated token string back into formatted python source code
detokenize_cpp_code: detokenize a space-separated token string back into formatted C++ source code
detokenize_java_code: detokenize a space-separated token string back into formatted Java source code
extract_functions_python: extract standalone and class functions from tokenized python source code
extract_functions_java: extract standalone and class methods from tokenized Java source code
extract_functions_cpp: extract standalone and class methods from tokenized C++ source code
extract_arguments_java: extract parameter types and names from a Java function signature string
